The Phenomenon of Life

词汇学习表 · 2485 词
Toward a Philosophical Biology · Hans Jonas
阅读前预习 · 词源助记 · 语境释义

如何使用本词表

  • 阅读顺序：先看单词与中文释义，再看原书例句。
  • 词源提示词根核心义，帮助理解多义项之间的关联。
  • 释义若含「另义」，第一个义项是原书语境中的准确含义。
  • 建议每日 30–50 词，三周覆盖全书。
  • 不必死背拼写，重点是识别与在语境中理解。
  • 若无法在句中认出某词，第二天再查一遍。

heavy with destiny

having decisive consequences for the future

featnoun

an act of notable skill or cleverness

feelernoun

源自 feel + -er，意为“感觉器官”

feigningverb

源自 古法语 feindre，意为“假装”
Plasticity is here instability, and we are left with the riddle of the latter’s feigning creativity.
felicitynoun

For the matter in hand is no mere felicity of speculation, but the real business and fortunes of the human race, and all power of operation. . . .

The progressive nervous centralization of the animal organism emphasizes the former, while correspondingly the environment becomes open space in which the free-moving sentient has to fend for itself.
fervornoun

fictitiousadjective

not real but invented, imagined, or merely apparent rather than actual

fifenoun
生命（原书作 life，OCR 误识）
the condition distinguishing living from nonliving things
原文为 life 的 OCR 误识。life 源自日耳曼语（古英语 līf「生命」），与德语 Leben 同源，本义「留存、存活」→ 生命。

figuraladjective

consisting of or forming human or animal figures
源自拉丁语 figura（形状），意为“形状的”

figurativeadjective

finiteadjective

finitudenoun

the condition of being limited, especially by time and death

That only man cares, in his finitude facing nothing but death, alone with his contingency and the objective meaninglessness of his projecting meanings, is a truly unprecedented situation.
firsthandadjective

源自拉丁语 fissionem，意为“分裂”

flatteringadjective
奉承的；讨好的
showing or representing to advantage
源自古法语 flater，意为‘抚摸’
In materialism, he looks his own negation in the eye; but since he at the same time, in what he does by thinking, exemplifies the very case to which his thought denies a place, he is here less in danger to forget one side of the question than is the follower of idealism, which with the primacy of thought, so flattering to the thinker, has in advance taken his side.

源自 古英语 flæsc，意为 肉

forcefuladjective

源自 中古英语 force，意为 力量，加后缀 -ful

源自古英语 forgān，意为“走过”

formulationnoun
